global: A vibrant bowl of ramen sits on a dark wooden table. Golden broth, tender pork, and fresh ingredients create a rich, aromatic scene.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with subtle grain and warm undertones
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, slightly textured surface and rounded edges
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth golden and clear with faint foam
regions.seaweed: Dark green nori seaweed, thin and crisp with slight wave-like folds
regions.meat: Golden seared chashu pork, tender and slightly crispy on edges
regions.menma: Golden menma bamboo shoots, slender and slightly translucent with a bumpy texture
regions.naruto: Swirled naruto fish cake, soft and marbled with a smooth, slightly chewy surface
